title: Message AI agent
help: Dellal, your AI salesperson, answers customers on WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and TikTok, gives prices, stock and delivery, and takes orders (they arrive in Confirmation). You can take over any conversation at any time.
off: {{name}} is off: messages arrive here but nobody answers automatically.

inbox.pickHint: Messages from WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and TikTok arrive here.

thread.modeHuman: You answer this customer: {{name}} is paused here.

tester.title: Try {{name}}
tester.help: Talk to {{name}} like a customer. It uses your real products, stock and delivery fees. Orders are only simulated.
tester.demoPreview: Preview: these answers come from a demo seller. On your server, with the AI key, Claude answers.
tester.demoNoKey: Demo answers: add the AI key in Settings so {{name}} answers with Claude.
tester.demoPilot: Demo answers: Pilotix’s AI is not on yet. As soon as Pilotix turns it on, {{name}} answers with Claude.
tester.inPage: In this page, {{name}} answers with Claude (your Claude account), with its real instructions, the demo's products and delivery fees, and the Darija check. A reply often takes 20 to 60 seconds.

results.title: {{name}}'s results
results.note: {{name}}'s orders follow the normal flow (confirmation, depot, delivery) and also count in the other statistics.

settings.enabledHint: Off: messages arrive in the inbox, without automatic answers.
settings.name: Agent name
settings.ordersNew: Confirmation › New (an agent calls before shipping)
settings.followUp: Follow up when the customer goes quiet
settings.followUpHint: One follow-up only, inside the 24 h WhatsApp and Messenger allow.
settings.modelHint: Sonnet: the right balance. Haiku: cheaper. Opus: the sharpest.
settings.nightHint: Otherwise night messages wait for the team in the morning.
settings.discountHint: Never above the product's maximum discount (Products).
settings.knowsHelp: {{name}} reads your products, variants, prices, stock, delivery fees and the customer's history by itself. Add here what is nowhere else.
settings.notesHint: Warranty, sizes, delays, exchanges, opening hours…
settings.notesPh: E.g.: 6-month warranty on strollers. Delivery in 24 to 72 h. Exchange possible within 3 days.
settings.handoff: Hand over to the team when…
settings.handoffHint: One reason per line. It also hands over when unsure or when the customer is upset.
settings.aiHelp: Dellal uses Claude (Anthropic). Create a key on console.anthropic.com: you pay Anthropic per message, usually a few dinars per conversation.
settings.aiNone: Without a key, {{name}} answers with the demo seller (simple rules).
settings.channelsHelp: In your Meta app (developers.facebook.com), add the WhatsApp and Messenger products, paste the address and token below in Webhooks, and subscribe to “messages”. Meta must review the app (a few days).
settings.tiktokHelp: TikTok opens its messaging only to approved business accounts. Once you have access (or through a relay tool), send the messages to this address.
settings.demo: Demo: channels do not receive real messages.
settings.darijaHelp: Before sending, {{name}} checks its message: Moroccan, Tunisian, Libyan, Egyptian or Middle-Eastern words, wrong phrases and your banned list are corrected automatically.
settings.darijaIntro: Have an Algerian seller from your team fill these two lists: that is what makes {{name}}'s Darija truly natural.
settings.darijaPreferHint: One per line: your own phrases, as you write them to customers.
settings.darijaPreferPh:
Mar7ba bik / biki
Saha khouya / khti
Tkhalles ki testalem
Bla mziya
settings.darijaAvoidHint: One per line. Put the right word after an arrow: “frero → khouya”.
